fix.notes: The fix is narrowly scoped to this one card. A more general fix would chain a second SubstitutionFilter in whoosh_constants.py to map '&' → 'and' before the strip pass, so all future ampersand card names are searchable via 'and' without needing an alias — noted as a potential follow-up. No other issues discovered.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The whoosh normalized analyzer uses `SubstitutionFilter(r"[\s/,_'-]", '')` which strips spaces, commas, and similar punctuation — but not `&`. So indexing `Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes` produces the normalized key `minsc&bootimelessheroes`. When a user searches `Minsc and Boo`, the normalized query is `minscandboo`, which has no prefix match against `minsc&boo…`.

## What changed

- **`card_aliases.tsv`** — added one line: `Minsc and Boo, Timeless Heroes\tMinsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes`. The alias is indexed under its own normalized form `minscandbootimelessheroes`, so the prefix query `minscandboo` now hits.
- **`magic/whoosh_search_test.py`** — added `test_ampersand_alias_finds_card`, a self-contained unit test (tmp whoosh index, no DB) that seeds a card with `&` in its name plus the `and` alias and asserts the prefix search returns the canonical name.

## How it was validated

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed
- Full unit suite (`uv run --frozen python dev.py unit`): **845 passed, 1 skipped** (no regressions)
- Targeted run `pytest magic/whoosh_search_test.py -k 'not functional'`: **4/4 passed** including the new test

Fixes #11443
